title: Binance Accelerator Program - QA (Content)
description: Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. Binance is trusted by more than 320 million people in 100+ countries for its industry-leading security, transparency, trading engine speed, protections for investors, and unmatched portfolio of digital asset products and offerings from trading and finance to education, research, social good, payments, institutional services, and Web3 features. Binance is devoted to building an inclusive crypto ecosystem to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world with crypto as the fundamental means. About Binance Accelerator Program Binance Accelerator Program (BAP) is a 3-6 month internship program designed for Early Career talent to have firsthand experience in the rapidly expanding digital assets space. You will be given the opportunity to develop your skills at Binance and understand what it’s like to work at the world's leading blockchain ecosystem. As part of your internship in the BAP, there will also be opportunities for networking and development, which will expand your professional network and build transferable skills to propel you forward in your career. Learn about the BAP Program HERE. Who may apply Current university students and recent graduates. *Terms of employment / engagement shall be subject to contract and local applicable laws Binance Square is Binance’s content community business, covering modules such as Feed recommendation, content publishing, livestreaming, creator center, and content moderation. Since its launch, it has gone through 65 product iterations and currently maintains a release cycle of one version every three weeks. The product spans six platforms: Android, iOS, Web, Admin, Mini Program, and Backend. You will join a 3-person QA team and participate in the full testing cycle of a real, high-traffic product. The team has already built a relatively complete toolchain, including automated tracking validation, test data generation plugins, regression scripts, and an online test case platform. You will not need to build everything from scratch; instead, you will be able to ramp up quickly within a mature process and make practical contributions.
